name: BRAND TEXT
description:
JNH Lifestyles has been in business since 2014 and pride themselves on their forward thinking infrared sauna designs. Considered by some to be a latecomer to the infrared sauna industry, JHN Lifestyles use this in their favour as their experienced engineers have been able to adapt and improve features of older style infrared saunas ensuring customers an infrared sauna that is designed to last.



JNH Lifestyles is based in Ontario, California and their mission is to help people across the USA look and feel their best. Many customers approach their showroom for advice frustrated that they can no longer manage their fatigue and hectic lifestyle. JNH Lifestyles is delighted to offer people a solution to remedy their stressful lives and increase their wellbeing. JNH promote use of their infrared saunas to work in tandem with a healthy lifestyle.



All JNH Lifestyle infrared saunas are tested by Intertek, a third party inspection company ensuring the highest quality of any infrared sauna that leaves the warehouse. However, if you experience any problems with your JNH Lifestyle sauna please contact Infrared Sauna Parts as we are able to help.
